summary: Gifford Pinchot NF summit in Skamania County WA: 1923 cupola, 1935 L-4 cab, lost in 1963. Sources differ on removed, destroyed or burned; a foundation is reported.

facts.design: 1923 D-6 cupola cabin, replaced in 1935 by a wooden L-4 cab on a tower
facts.status_note: The tower and cab were lost in 1963. The sources describe a foundation at the summit.

visit.trail_note: Good gravel road to the last half mile, then 4WD. The road ends just below the high point, and the summit still needs some bushwhacking.

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Gifford Pinchot National Forest

events.note: Willhite says the lookout is labeled on the 1912 Columbia National Forest map; the other sources start in 1923
Cupola cabin (D-6 design per Willhite and washingtonlookouts)
Wooden L-4 cab. Register and firelookout.com say 15 ft; Willhite and washingtonlookouts say 12 ft
Register says removed; firelookout.com says destroyed; Willhite and washingtonlookouts say burned

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record's D-6 label fits the 1923 cupola. The sources also describe a wooden L-4 cab from 1935, so the design line covers both.
All four sources agree the tower was gone after 1963. They differ only on how it ended: removed, destroyed or burned.

notes_for_editor: Height disagrees: the record's 3.7 m (12 ft) matches Willhite and washingtonlookouts, but the register and firelookout.com give 15 ft. Height is left out of facts until someone checks. Willhite's 1912 map note is the only reference before 1923; it is reported, not resolved. No staffing source was found in the pages read. The register lists the Forest Service as administrator; no access rule is stated in the pages read. The record's coordinates match the register's coordinates. No correction proposed.
